raw_response:
The figure presents three donut charts comparing the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover across four economic sectors—Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services—in 2021, with data expressed as percentages of the total economy and absolute values. Each chart is segmented into four colored portions corresponding to the sectors, with a legend at the bottom indicating that Industry is gold, Construction is blue, Trade is red, and Other Services is dark blue. The leftmost chart, “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES,” shows Other Services at 61% (19.0 million), Trade at 19% (5.9 million), Construction at 12% (3.7 million), and Industry at 8% (2.4 million). The middle chart, “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED,” shows Other Services at 51% (80.2 million), Industry at 21% (33.0 million), Trade at 19% (29.5 million), and Construction at 9% (13.4 million). The rightmost chart, “TURNOVER,” shows Industry at 33% (10.6 trillion), Other Services and Trade each at 31% (9.8 and 9.9 trillion respectively), and Construction at 6% (1.9 trillion). All charts include percentage labels and absolute values within their respective segments, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size within each chart. The charts are visually distinct, with the “NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES” chart having the largest segment for Other Services, the “NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED” chart having the largest segment for Other Services, and the “TURNOVER” chart having the largest segment for Industry. The figure is sourced from Eurostat.
